role: post-hoc diagnostic amendment to104; specified before the new sensitivity results, not preregistration
preservation: Retain primary predictions and completed sensitivity results; this analysis does not retrain base models.

seed_aggregation.excluded: No fabricated per-seed CB-SF/DASF/derived blend/recording stacker results. Corrected Riemannian predictions are deterministic and not five independent random fits; old Riemannian seed replicas are excluded.
seed_aggregation.primary_order: At each identical window take componentwise median over five seeds, normalize, then geometric mean over windows in the recording, normalize and argmax; ties choose class0
seed_aggregation.sensitivity_order: Change only the window-level across-seed median to mean; retain all other steps
seed_aggregation.required_check: All1140 median recording probabilities must reproduce118 for the six covered methods within1e-10, with exactly identical decisions
seed_aggregation.wrong_order_diagnostic: Also quantify recording-first then seed-median differences; label these as aggregation-order diagnostics, not main mean-versus-median sensitivity
seed_aggregation.inference: participant balanced accuracy, five settings including two directions and bidirectional cross-task paired within person;10000 participant percentile bootstrap; exact two-sided sign-flip sums; one separate BH family of30 mean-minus-median comparisons
seed_aggregation.claim_limit: seeds are not independent participants; retain median as primary regardless of which has higher accuracy

refits: full fit reproducing saved gate and118 predictions
cbsf_stability.rng_derivation: SHA256 of131|260903|cbsf|protocol|direction|subject; first8 bytes unsigned little endian; numpy PCG64
diagnostics: ridge and logistic coefficient signs/ranges in resample-specific robust standardized coordinates
absent single-class logistic models explicitly flagged, not imputed
cbsf_stability.row_bootstrap_limit: Cross-task has two direction rows per training person; row perturbations are not an independence-respecting participant bootstrap. All resulting ranges are descriptive algorithm-input stability ranges, not population confidence intervals.
cbsf_stability.coefficient_limit: Coefficient scales change when resample robust scaling changes; signs/ranges are diagnostics, not physiological effects or causal feature importance.
cbsf_stability.target_label_policy: Pass only five label-free target diagnostics into gate refits. Target labels or target benefit must never enter a fit.
cbsf_stability.no_risk_claim: Stability, low weight, or OOD fallback does not establish risk control, safety or online applicability. Lambda>0.4 is not the DASF decision rule.

dasf_stability.rule: Gain = median(fusion validation accuracy)-median(neural validation accuracy); select fusion iff gain>clip(0.02+0.2*median(covariance shift),0,0.15)
checks: all270 seed decisions and54 final cells reproduce saved diagnostics
dasf_stability.rng_derivation: SHA256 of131|260903|dasf|protocol|direction|subject; first8 bytes unsigned little endian; numpy PCG64
dasf_stability.limit: DASF is a fixed hard rule, not the learned CB-SF gate. Seed perturbations are model-randomness diagnostics, not independent-subject inference or meta-row refits.

failure_and_resume: Fail on missing/duplicate inputs, stale checksums, mismatched full-fit predictions, nonfinite values or convergence warnings. Atomic per-cell gate checkpoints allow resume; never skip difficult cells.

publication_export.path_format: publication-relative paths; workstation executable location omitted
publication_export.presentation_changes: Paths standardized and non-scientific workflow notes removed; scientific values retained.
publication_export.embedded_hash_scope: original execution artifacts; see SOURCE_INDEX.csv for publication hashes
